methodology: Match CatholicCulture hosted source passages to a scanned printed primary anthology; distinguish what is source text reproduction from proof of independent historical testimony. Printed volume date not assumed. The other paired printed books have not been newly rechecked. Previously screened Weiser material is not silently counted as fresh pair-level verification.

printed_volume.title: Your Home, A Church in Miniature

important_findings: The printed anthology reveals four actual contributors behind six online excerpts: Rev. Alphonse Westhoff, Maria Augusta Trapp, Ann Michna and Rev. J. Albert Le Blanc.
Web-hosted excerpt and its antecedent printed page are ONE textual witness, never two independent attestations.
Two Louisiana cases use the same printed page; two Easter-baptism/water cases likewise share one printed page.
Mexican funeral earth gesture and Louisiana French burial earth gesture are distinguishable in printed source; their cross gesture and actor cannot be merged.
Slovak oblatky baking/delivery differs from Polish oplatek sharing and Slovak household honeyed serving.
Original printed work is not the 1994 Neumann Press reprint, and the scanned volume's edition date is not claimed without source proof.
